app.description: Mai fassarar subtitle na SRT, VTT da ASS, kyauta kuma buɗaɗɗen tushe. Ba rajista.
application.accessibility: Alamomin tsari da kanun labarai, kewayawa mai lakabi, mahaɗin tsallakewa, abin nuna maɓalli a bayyane, sarrafawa ta madannai, jigon haske da duhu, da goyon bayan rage motsi.
application.feature.1: Fassara fage-fage: ana gane jimloli da fage kai tsaye, sannan a fassara su gaba ɗaya
application.feature.10: Harsuna 200+ babu rajista, babu talla, babu bin diddigi
application.feature.11: Buɗaɗɗen tushe ƙarƙashin lasisin MIT; ba a taɓa adana abun cikin subtitle ba
application.feature.12: Yana ciro waƙoƙin subtitle kai tsaye daga bidiyon MKV a burauzarka, ba ɗorawa ba, ba ƙarin manhaja ba
application.feature.2: Yana kiyaye ma’ana daidai, kalmomi iri ɗaya, alaƙar haruffa daidai da mahallin da ya haɗu
application.feature.3: Yana kiyaye kowane lokaci na asali kuma yana mayar da fassara daidai kan layukan asali
application.feature.4: Ƙamus da bayanan labari masu jagorantar kalmomi da yanayin magana
application.feature.5: Edita na dubawa da ke nuna layukan da suka ɓace, masu tsawo, masu sauri da waɗanda ba a fassara ba kafin zazzagewa
application.feature.6: Fitarwa ta harsuna biyu ko fassara kaɗai, da tsarin rubutun subtitle na ƙwararru ga harsuna 200+
application.feature.7: Zaɓuɓɓukan ƙwararru: na’urar fassara, ƙamus, bayanan labari, karya layi, tarawar harsuna biyu da tsarin ASS na kwamfuta da waya
application.feature.8: Fassara fayiloli da yawa, manyan fayiloli da ma’ajiyar ZIP a lokaci ɗaya
application.feature.9: Sauya tsakanin SRT, VTT da ASS, da cire layukan SDH
organization.description: Al’ummar subtitle ta buɗaɗɗen tushe, marar neman riba, mai haɗa masu kallo, masu fassara, masu haɓaka manhaja da ƙwararrun fim.
page.about.description: Yadda wannan mai fassarar subtitle ke aiki: ana haɗa layuka zuwa cikakkun jimloli, a tara su cikin fage-fage, a fassara da fassarar na’ura ta neural, sannan a mayar da su daidai kan tsarin lokaci na asali. Da dalilin da ya sa al’ummar MontageSubs ta gina shi.
